ios.desc:
Cueso helps you organize grocery shopping by store and stay focused while you shop.

Create shopping lists for each store, plan ahead at home, and check off items as you go. Cueso keeps your trips simple, intentional, and distraction-free.
Features:
• Organize shopping lists by store
• Plan lists at home or in-store
• Check off items while shopping
• Track recent shopping activity
• Clean, calm interface designed for focus

Cueso is built to reduce mental load and help you shop with confidence.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Cueso – iPhone app for location-based grocery reminders

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built Cueso, an iPhone app that reminds you of your grocery list when you arrive at stores you already shop at.

It’s fully on-device, uses location awareness, and opens the right list automatically when you are near a store.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cueso/id6756196364
Short demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d9jkFA8-qwo

I would love feedback on the UX, usefulness, and edge cases.

Happy to answer questions about the design or implementation.
